usedFor: Flutterwave holds payments and subscriptions, and MailerLite holds your mailing list, so “New Subscription” runs “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Subscription” in Flutterwave, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: A paying subscriber lands on your MailerLite list, and a repeat customer is updated instead of duplicated.

watchOut: “New Subscription” in Flutterwave is polling, so the MailerLite subscriber appears after a scheduled check.
